_notes: Labyrinth tiles read from a top-down photo of the physical tiles (Cycle I).
Local grid: x to the right, y downward (as photographed, tile unrotated). Each cell lists the sides that carry a red line (wall): N/E/S/W.
Red lines = Obstacle + Obscuring for Titans (block movement, LoS, adjacency). Primordials ignore Labyrinth for movement/attack but red lines block their LoS for targeting.
Green dashes = connector sides (no wall). Tiles may be rotated in 90° steps.
